Besides, transmis- sion deadline monitoring timer shall not be restarted.

Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02037 When a transmission deadline monitoring timer elapses and there was no successful transmit confirmation for an I-PDU in time, the AUTOSAR COM module shall first notify the users (e.g. RTE, SwCluC) by invoking all configured <ComUser_CbkTxTOut> for contained signals or signal groups. Afterwards, the AUTOSAR COM shall notify Dem via Dem_SetEventStatus API with DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREFAILED if COM_E_ TIMEOUT is configured for contained signals or signal groups. Besides, transmission deadline monitoring timer shall not be restarted.
